sources.name: MarkTechPost
sources.summary: Meituan has released LongCat-2.0, a 1.6 trillion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model that activates about 48 billion parameters per token. It pairs a native 1-million-token context, built on LongCat Sparse Attention, with training and serving run end-to-end on domestic AI ASIC superpods. Here is the architecture, the vendor-reported benchmarks, the API access path, and what remains unverified. The post Meituan Releases LongCat-2.0: A 1.6T-Parameter Open MoE Model with Native 1M Context and LongCat Sparse Attention appeared first on MarkTechPost .
